name: WisconsiNxN 2025
information:
**Note: WI-83 is currently closed north of the venue. This does not affect travel from I-94 (coming from West/South/East). If you are coming from I-41 (North), you will need to find an alternate route. Apple Maps currently has more accurate information about the road closure than Google Maps.**

New to competing? This competition is a good one to be your first!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
